description: Request-level input assurance for the controlled tomato-leaf prototype.

rules.description: Required input reference, supported declared image format, and positive dimensions with minimum 32x32.
Only controlled PlantVillage-style color images are within the current prototype evidence scope.
Any request explicitly marked for review must be routed to a person rather than predicted automatically.

runtime_preprocessing_note: Defined by inference code, not accepted from the request. Resize to 64x64 with bilinear interpolation, then compute three normalized 16-bin RGB histograms.
